messages:
harper: Quick heads-up: publishing a customer-facing "pinning primer" and a small SDK compatibility patch next week. Short goal: make it trivial for customers to pin a model variant and understand runtime_weight tradeoffs.

yuki: timeline?

harper: Draft schedule: 2026-04-07 publish primer + FAQ; 2026-04-14 SDK patch (minor) that adds `rw pin-suggest` and a non-blocking deprecation log for implicit selection; 2026-05-05 docs CI starts warning on examples without recommended_pin.

docs-bot: Draft primer uploaded: https://go.redwood/internal/pinning-primer (internal). It contains copy, quick CLI snippets, and a one-line explanation for each runtime_weight.

eng-sdk: SDK patch note: patch will expose `pin_suggest()` in the SDK and add a `--dry-run` flag for the CLI. No default behavior changes until 2026-05-05.

sam: for Dedicated customers, should we recommend a different default?

harper: yes  note in primer: Dedicated/private customers should pin to their vetted local variants; we'll add a short checklist per deployment type.

yuki: can we add a tiny telemetry tile in the console showing unpinned example count? helps track adoption.

docs-bot: I'll add a filter in the docs dashboard and a one-click export for CSMs.

cs-m-bot: CSM outreach: I'll auto-generate a suggested-email template with recommended pins for top accounts after we run `pin-suggest` on last 7 days of traffic.

harper: action items: @eng-sdk create patch PR, @docs-bot finalize primer + FAQ, @csm-bot prepare outreach flow. Q&A session 2026-04-08 11:00 PT.

yuki: LGTM. Keep the messaging simple for non-technical customers.

harper: agreed  one paragraph "why pin" + one paragraph "how to roll back" in the primer. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
